styles.title: Neumorphism / Soft UI
styles.short: Monochrome surfaces where every element is extruded from the same background using twin light and dark shadows.
styles.long: Neumorphism keeps a single off-white or light-grey background and makes components appear pressed into or raised out of it, using a pale highlight on one corner and a soft grey shadow on the opposite one. Nothing has a border and almost nothing has a fill — depth is the only affordance. It is beautiful and notoriously low-contrast, so accent colours are reserved for the one or two actions that matter.

traits.Typography: Geometric sans (Gilroy, Poppins) with wide tracking on headings, very light weights for body.
traits.Layout: Generous padding, large corner radii (20–32px), floating cards on a flat field.
traits.Colour: One background tone plus a lighter and darker derivative; saturated accents used sparingly.
traits.Motion: Press states that invert the shadow direction — outset becomes inset.

styles.title: Vintage Newspaper
styles.short: A broadsheet transplanted to the browser — masthead, rules, drop caps and multi-column body copy on aged paper.
styles.long: This style borrows the full grammar of 19th- and 20th-century print journalism: an all-caps masthead in a fat display serif, a dateline and volume number, hairline rules dividing every zone, three-to-four text columns, drop caps opening each story and halftone-treated photography. The paper texture and slightly warped ink do the heavy lifting; the layout itself is deliberately dense and un-modern.

traits.Typography: Didone or slab display for the masthead, old-style serif for body, italic standfirsts, small caps subheads.
traits.Layout: Rigid vertical columns with visible dividing rules; centred headline stacks; boxed pull-quotes.
traits.Colour: Cream and newsprint tan with near-black ink; a single muted spot colour at most.
traits.Motion: Almost none — page turns and simple fades keep the print illusion intact.

styles.title: Sliced Monochrome Editorial
styles.short: A single greyscale photograph cut into offset vertical panels, captioned like a gallery wall label.
styles.long: One high-contrast black-and-white image is sliced into vertical bands of varying height and nudged out of alignment, so the eye reassembles the subject while reading the gaps as rhythm. Typography is tiny, all-caps and set in a fine serif at the bottom edge, treated as a wall label rather than a headline. The whole composition lives or dies on the quality of the light in the source photograph.

traits.Typography: Fine transitional serif, all caps, heavy letterspacing, 11–13px, no bold anywhere.
traits.Layout: 5–7 vertical slices with staggered top and bottom edges; caption block anchored bottom-left.
traits.Colour: Pure greyscale; the only 'colour' is the tonal gradient of the photograph.
traits.Motion: Slices drift at different parallax speeds on scroll.

styles.title: Retro Flat & Textured
styles.short: Early-2010s indie web: speckled paper, ultra-condensed slab headlines and long ribbon graphics folding down the page.
styles.long: A warm speckled cream background carries chunky condensed slab or gothic headlines set tight and all-caps, small dark label chips for section titles, and long flat ribbon shapes that fold at 90 degrees to lead the eye down the page. Colour is a muted mid-century quartet — sage, dusty teal, wheat, burnt orange. It reads handmade and confident rather than corporate.

traits.Typography: Ultra-condensed gothic display (League Gothic style) at huge sizes, humanist sans for body.
traits.Layout: Single wide column with full-bleed graphic ribbons; two-column feature blocks.
traits.Colour: Speckled cream ground, four muted mid-century accents, near-black ink.
traits.Motion: Simple anchored scrolling; the ribbons imply movement without animating.

styles.title: Emerald Supper Club
styles.short: Deep green and gold, warm tungsten photography and a filmic 1970s-hotel-bar mood.
styles.long: Saturated forest-green bands frame lush, warm-lit photography — velvet, brass, glassware, mustard silk. Headlines mix a high-contrast serif with an italic accent word, and body copy stays small and quiet so the imagery holds the room. Grids are asymmetric and gallery-like, with images cropped tight enough to feel like film stills rather than stock.

traits.Typography: High-contrast display serif for headings with an italic word for emphasis; wide-tracked caps for nav.
traits.Layout: Full-bleed hero strips alternating with tight mosaic image grids.
traits.Colour: Forest green and near-black grounds, cream text, gold and mustard highlights from the photography.
traits.Motion: Slow crossfades and horizontal carousels; nothing bounces.

styles.title: Terracotta Editorial Portfolio
styles.short: Burnt-orange fields, oversized italic serif and loose ribbon squiggles behind small greyscale photos.
styles.long: Big flat terracotta blocks alternate with bone-white ones, and an enormous display serif — often part roman, part italic — runs across the seam. Thin hand-drawn ribbon lines meander behind the type as a watermark, and small desaturated fashion photographs are dropped in at irregular sizes. Skills and services get pill or circle treatments so the page never feels like a CV.

traits.Typography: Large Didone or transitional serif; italic for the hero word; small all-caps tracked labels.
traits.Layout: Full-width colour bands with overlapping photo insets breaking the band edges.
traits.Colour: One dominant warm earth tone plus bone white; photography desaturated so it never competes.
traits.Motion: Type reveals line-by-line; squiggles draw themselves on scroll.

styles.long: A single dramatic photograph — building, storm, terrain — fills the viewport, and a giant cream display word is laid over it with a contrasting calligraphic script for the second half of the name. A translucent frosted panel carries the project metadata in small print. Pill-shaped navigation floats at the top, and thin ruled columns of text anchor the bottom edge.

traits.Typography: Wide geometric or grotesk caps at 180px+, paired with a fine calligraphic script; 12px mono-ish captions.
traits.Layout: Edge-to-edge image, type overlaid at optical centre, metadata card offset lower-left, footer text columns.
traits.Colour: Desaturated stormy neutrals lifted by one warm cream.
traits.Motion: Slow scale-up on the hero image; text fades in after the image settles.

styles.title: 8-Bit Arcade
styles.short: Black CRT ground, perspective grid horizon, chunky bitmap type with hard offset outlines and 1UP/HI-SCORE chrome.
styles.long: Everything is built to look like a coin-op attract screen: a pure black field, a white vanishing-point grid running to the horizon, a headline in a heavy bitmap face with a red fill and yellow outline, and interface furniture borrowed from arcade HUDs — 1UP, HI-SCORE, heart lives, blinking START/CONTINUE prompts. Content cards get pixel-stepped borders instead of curves.

traits.Typography: Bitmap / pixel display faces with 2px offset outlines; monospace for all supporting copy.
traits.Layout: Centred attract-screen hero, then a strict grid of bordered content panels.
traits.Colour: Black ground, red and yellow primaries, white grid lines.
traits.Motion: Blinking cursors, step-wise (non-eased) transitions, scanline flicker.

styles.title: Soft Minimal Product
styles.short: Near-white studio backdrop, one product hero, pill navigation and lowercase type that the product physically occludes.
styles.long: A hushed off-white page where the product is photographed on an infinity backdrop and the wordmark is set in enormous lowercase behind it, so the object visibly interrupts the letterforms. Controls are small pills and circles; colour swatches and price sit in floating rounded cards. Section labels are tiny all-caps above hairline rules, and everything breathes.

traits.Typography: Geometric sans in lowercase at display sizes; 11px all-caps tracked labels for sections.
traits.Layout: Full-width hero, then a clean three-up product grid, then an asymmetric feature mosaic.
traits.Colour: Whites and pale greys with muted product colours as the only saturation.
traits.Motion: Cursor-follow play buttons, gentle card lifts, no bounce.

styles.title: Swiss / International Typographic
styles.short: Two colours, one grid, extended grotesk headlines and rules — objectivity as an aesthetic.
styles.long: The International Typographic Style reduces a page to a mathematical grid, flush-left ranged-right text, and one or two flat colours. Headlines are set in an extended or condensed grotesk at maximum size, horizontal rules separate every information band, and any illustration is a flat vector reduced to the same palette. Data — schedules, times, names — is laid out as a table and treated as ornament in its own right.

traits.Typography: Extended grotesk for display, a high-contrast serif for secondary headlines, one text size for everything else.
traits.Layout: Strict modular grid; full-width rules; centred data tables; no decoration.
traits.Colour: One saturated primary against cream or white; the primary inverts for the footer band.
traits.Motion: Instant. Any animation would undermine the objectivity.

styles.title: Retro OS / Windows 95
styles.short: Beige chrome, 1px borders, bevelled buttons, title bars with minimise-maximise-close and a blue selection highlight.
styles.long: A faithful revival of mid-90s desktop UI: window chrome with a saturated blue title bar, grey bevelled buttons with light top-left and dark bottom-right edges, 1px solid borders everywhere, checkbox and radio controls at 13px, and system-blue selection states. Type is a bitmap face for headings and a plain UI sans for everything else. Radii are 0 to 4px and shadows are forbidden.

traits.Typography: Pixel/bitmap display face for H1, plain UI sans (Tahoma-like) for all body and controls.
traits.Layout: Panel-in-panel composition; toolbars, tab strips, status bars, modal dialogs.
traits.Colour: Greys and off-white with exactly one system blue accent and one alert red.
traits.Motion: None. Instant state changes, no easing.

styles.title: Exposed-Grid Sport
styles.short: Visible layout grid lines, cut-out athlete photography, monospace micro-copy and one acid-green highlight bar.
styles.long: The underlying column grid is drawn on the page as faint lines and never hidden, so the composition reads like a designer's working file. Headlines are heavy grotesk in sentence case, all supporting copy is monospace and uppercase at 11px, and athletes are cut out from their backgrounds and dropped across grid intersections. One acid or lime bar sweeps behind the active row of a list.

traits.Typography: Heavy neo-grotesk for headings, uppercase monospace at 11px for every label and paragraph.
traits.Layout: 12-column grid rendered as visible 1px lines; elements deliberately straddle columns.
traits.Colour: Paper white and black with a single fluorescent accent.
traits.Motion: Row highlight slides; cut-out figures parallax against the static grid.

styles.short: One saturated cool hue, an enormous high-contrast serif logotype and a sparse image grid with an empty crossed placeholder.
styles.long: A single cool colour — ice blue, klein, glacier — is used for every mark on a white page, including the photography, which is colour-graded to match. The name is set in a very large high-contrast serif with tight tracking, and imagery is placed in a wide, deliberately gappy grid where one cell is left as a crossed rectangle. Micro-copy is tiny, grey and set in a neutral sans.

traits.Typography: High-contrast Didone-ish serif at 120–200px; 11px neutral sans for all supporting text.
traits.Layout: Wide five-column image band with intentional empty cells; headline blocks span the full measure.
traits.Colour: White ground, one saturated cool hue at full strength plus two tints.
traits.Motion: Letterspacing tightens on load; images fade up in sequence.

styles.short: Greige page, a condensed sans headline with one italic serif line, a cut-out portrait and a stat rail.
styles.long: Warm grey-beige replaces white as the ground, softening everything on it. The hero mixes a tight condensed sans with a single italic serif line for the role, sets a cut-out portrait inside a rounded arch, and runs a right-hand rail of oversized numeric stats. Below, four short capability columns sit under hairline rules, followed by a logo wall in a bordered table.

traits.Typography: Condensed grotesk display mixed with one italic serif line; 10px all-caps labels.
traits.Layout: Two-thirds hero with right stat rail, four-column capability row, bordered logo grid.
traits.Colour: Warm greys with black text; no accent colour at all.
traits.Motion: Numbers count up; sections fade in with slight upward drift.

styles.long: The hero is a single soft-focus photograph running the full width and most of the height, with a light-weight serif headline centred over it and a tiny tracked call-to-action beneath. Below, six images butt against each other with no gutters at all, each carrying a small caps location label and an italic couple name in the lower-left corner. Text sections are set in a fine serif with enormous leading.

traits.Typography: Light-weight transitional serif for headings, italic for names, 10px tracked caps for labels.
traits.Layout: Zero-gutter mosaic grids; text sections centred in a narrow measure.
traits.Colour: Whatever the photography brings, muted; UI colour is white and near-black only.
traits.Motion: Slow ken-burns on the hero, crossfade slideshows.

styles.title: Magazine Cover Collage
styles.short: A masthead the full width of the page, partially hidden behind the subject, with cover lines set as justified italic blocks.
styles.long: The defining move is the masthead–subject overlap: a huge lowercase geometric wordmark sits behind the model's head so the letters are half-occluded. The image itself is split into offset vertical panels, one in colour and the rest desaturated. Cover lines are small justified italic paragraphs pinned to the right edge, and a barcode anchors the bottom corner as pure typographic furniture.

traits.Typography: Very large lowercase geometric sans masthead; small justified italic serif for cover lines.
traits.Layout: Vertical panel split with an occluded masthead; text pinned to hard edges.
traits.Colour: Near-black ground, greyscale imagery, one panel left in muted colour.
traits.Motion: The masthead slides behind the subject on load.

styles.short: A flat pastel-lime field with oversized monochrome pixel-art illustration and monospace body copy.
styles.long: One saturated pastel colour fills the entire page — no white anywhere — and a single very large pixel-art illustration acts as the hero image. Every paragraph is monospace, left-aligned, at a fixed measure, and headings use a squared-off geometric sans. Section markers are short thick rules and zigzag lines rather than boxes, and buttons are simple 1px rectangles.

traits.Layout: Wide single column with alternating two-up feature rows; browser chrome framing the page.
traits.Colour: One flat pastel ground, black type, white illustration fills.
traits.Motion: Step-wise hover states that snap rather than ease.

styles.title: Monochrome Swiss Corporate
styles.short: Pure black on white, a bold-and-light headline pair, faded landscape imagery and disciplined three-column feature rows.
styles.long: The most durable template on the web: white page, black type, one accent-free palette. Headlines pair a light weight with a bold weight of the same family on consecutive lines. Photography is high-key and faded so it merges into the white background. Features run as three columns with a line icon, a bold label and two lines of body, and forms sit in a pale grey card with a solid black submit button.

traits.Typography: One neo-grotesk family, light and bold weights only; a serif reserved for pull-quotes.
traits.Layout: Centred 1140px measure, three-column feature rows, footer link columns.
traits.Colour: Black, white and two greys. No accent.
traits.Motion: Restrained fades; hover underlines.

styles.long: Warm amber and sepia photography sets the entire mood, and the interface stays deliberately fragile around it: a very small letterspaced serif wordmark centred over the hero image, a hand-drawn line-art crest as the logo, thin caps navigation and three-up image rows with generous white margins. traits.Typography: Fine serif with 0.3em letterspacing for the wordmark; 9–10px tracked caps everywhere else.
traits.Layout: Framed page (white margin around the whole design), full-width image bands, three-up thumbnails.
traits.Colour: Warm neutrals lifted by the amber of the photography.
traits.Motion: Crossfade galleries; text fades only.

Product photography is natural-light still life on plaster surfaces, and typography is a quiet letterspaced serif over a small neutral sans.

traits.Layout: Arch-topped page container; overlapping circular image masks; centred narrow text blocks.
traits.Colour: Taupe and oatmeal with white cards; no saturated colour anywhere.
traits.Motion: Soft parallax between the ellipse outline and the product images.

styles.title: Monochrome Creative Agency
styles.short: Greyscale everything — hero, portfolio, footer — with weight and scale doing all the differentiation.
styles.long: A classic agency one-pager stripped of colour entirely. The hero is a desaturated landscape with a two-tone wordmark, work is shown as a greyscale masonry grid behind a pill filter row, and the footer inverts to black. Because there is no colour, hierarchy comes purely from type weight, scale and the amount of air around each block.

traits.Layout: Centred hero, pill filter row, four-column masonry, black footer band.
traits.Colour: Pure greyscale; images desaturated to match.
traits.Motion: Filter transitions reflow the grid; images desaturate on hover.

styles.short: Rendered interiors in impossible saturated colours, stacked as full-width bands with almost no chrome.
styles.long: Each section is a full-bleed 3D render of a stylised room — fluted walls, rounded furniture, a single plant — bathed in one saturated hue: cobalt, tangerine, violet, teal. The colour changes completely between bands, which is the whole point.

traits.Typography: Friendly geometric sans, medium weight, white on render; occasional script accent.
traits.Layout: Stacked full-width render bands; text pinned to one third of each band.
traits.Colour: A different saturated hue per band; no neutral ground at all.

styles.title: Film-Tone Portfolio Grid

traits.Typography: Tiny heavily tracked caps for everything; no display type at all.
traits.Layout: Hero frame, then a 4×3 modular grid mixing 1×1, 1×2 and 2×2 cells.
traits.Colour: Warm film neutrals; UI in charcoal and white only.

styles.title: Hand-Drawn Doodle Brand

Body copy stays a plain compact sans so the page remains readable.

traits.Typography: Custom hand-drawn bubble display for headlines; a compact grotesk for body; all-caps tiny labels.
traits.Layout: Full-width bands with wavy dividers; illustration bleeding past every edge.
traits.Colour: Yellow and orange dominant, teal and brown as support, black outlines throughout.
traits.Motion: Characters wobble and blink; badges rotate slowly.

traits.Layout: Poster proportions; header rule, three stacked display lines, hairline rule, small glyph blocks.
traits.Colour: Black ground with white-to-grey type tones as the only variation.

styles.title: Industrial Product Realism

traits.Layout: Object centred with vast white margin; specs floated far from the subject.
traits.Colour: White and metal greys with the product's own red index marks as accent.
traits.Motion: Slow rotation and macro zoom on scroll.

styles.title: Isometric Type Sculpture

styles.long: Type is treated as a physical environment: a numeral or word is repeated and extruded into an isometric landscape of walls, ledges and stairs, rendered in exactly two tones so the depth reads as pure graphic shape. traits.Layout: Poster proportions, single composition, no scrolling content.
traits.Colour: Two tones only — a warm bone and a cool charcoal.

styles.title: Neo-Brutalist UI
styles.short: Thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, flat candy colours and monospace headings that refuse to be polite.
styles.long: Neo-brutalism takes the raw web's honesty and makes it fun: every element gets a 2–3px black border and a solid offset shadow with no blur, corner radii are 0–4px, and the palette is unmixed candy — lime, lemon, hot pink, sky. traits.Layout: Sidebar plus card grid, everything outlined; layered diagonal colour wedges behind the frame.
traits.Colour: Unmixed flat brights with pure black outlines and cream ground.
traits.Motion: Shadows shift on hover as if the element physically moves.

styles.title: Dark Masonry Albums

styles.title: Flat 2.0 Colour Blocks
styles.short: Zig-cut colour panels, flat line icons, thin geometric type and cut-out product photography on white.
styles.long: The refined descendant of flat design: full-width rows split into panels of mint, lemon, lime and slate, with zigzag or torn edges where panels meet. traits.Typography: Thin geometric sans for headings; small caps labels; italic script for collection names.
traits.Layout: Full-width rows split into unequal panels with zigzag seams; product cut-outs breaking panel edges.
traits.Colour: Mint, lemon, lime and slate against off-white; no gradients.
traits.Motion: Panels slide in from alternating sides.

styles.long: A modern product landing built entirely from rounded outlined cards of different spans, packed edge to edge like a bento box. traits.Layout: Left bento wall of small cards balanced by a large right-hand headline block.

styles.title: Glassmorphism
styles.short: Frosted translucent panels floating over a saturated blurred gradient, edged with a 1px light border.
styles.long: Panels are semi-transparent with a heavy backdrop blur, a subtle white inner border along the top-left edge, and a soft shadow beneath. The background must be colourful and out of focus for the effect to read at all — usually a mesh gradient or a blurred photograph. Depth is communicated by how much blur and how bright the border is, so layering more than three planes stops working.

traits.Typography: Clean geometric sans, medium weight, white or near-white; nothing thin (blur eats it).
traits.Layout: Floating cards over a full-bleed gradient; nav as a floating capsule.
traits.Colour: Saturated blurred backdrop with white-alpha surfaces at 8–20% opacity.
traits.Motion: Cards drift on pointer move; blur radius increases on the layer behind a modal.

styles.title: Claymorphism
styles.short: Puffy inflated 3D shapes with big radii, double inner shadows and a candy-pastel palette.
styles.long: Elements look moulded from soft clay: very large corner radii (30–50px), a light outer shadow, and two inner shadows — a bright one at the top-left and a darker one at the bottom-right — that inflate the surface. Illustrations are chunky 3D primitives in the same pastel range. It is friendly and toy-like, which suits onboarding, kids' products and playful SaaS.

traits.Typography: Rounded geometric sans (Nunito, Poppins) at bold weights; no serifs.
traits.Layout: Wide cards with generous padding; 3D illustration bleeding past card edges.
traits.Colour: Pastel violet, mint and blush with a deep plum for text.
traits.Motion: Elements squash slightly on press, like real clay.

styles.title: Vaporwave Chrome
styles.short: Liquid chrome type, magenta-to-cyan gradients, wireframe grids and Roman busts on a purple dusk.
styles.long: A hyper-specific nostalgia for a 1990s that never existed: chromed and bevelled 3D lettering with rainbow reflections, sunset gradients running magenta to cyan, a wireframe grid receding to a horizon, palm silhouettes, plaster busts and stray Japanese katakana. traits.Typography: Chromed bevelled 3D display lettering; a wide 90s sans or bitmap face for captions.
traits.Layout: Poster-like centred compositions; horizon line at the lower third.
traits.Colour: Purple dusk ground with magenta-cyan gradient and warm sunset highlights.
traits.Motion: The grid scrolls toward the viewer; chrome reflections sweep.

styles.title: Cyberpunk Neon
styles.short: Black grounds cut by cyan and magenta glow, glitched type, corner-clipped panels and dense HUD data.
styles.long: Interfaces that look like they belong on a rain-soaked street: near-black backgrounds, panels with clipped corners and thin neon borders that emit a real glow, monospace data readouts stacked densely, and headline type that occasionally glitches into RGB-split ghosts. traits.Typography: Condensed techno display for headings; monospace for all data; uppercase throughout.
traits.Layout: Panels with clipped corners, dense left data rails, wide empty centre.
traits.Colour: Near-black with two neon hues; never more than two glowing colours at once.
traits.Motion: Flicker, scanline sweep, typewriter reveals on data.

styles.title: Memphis Postmodern
styles.short: Squiggles, confetti dots, terrazzo speckle and clashing primaries arranged with cheerful disregard for the grid.
styles.long: The 1980s Memphis Group vocabulary: black squiggle lines, half-circles, zigzag bands, confetti dots and terrazzo speckle scattered across bold flat colour fields. Shapes never explain themselves and rarely align. Typography is a wide geometric sans or a bouncy display face, and drop shadows are hard, offset and often in a contrasting hue rather than grey.

traits.Typography: Wide geometric sans or bouncy display; coloured hard drop shadows on headings.
traits.Layout: Deliberately unaligned; shapes float freely and overlap content edges.
traits.Colour: Four clashing brights on white or cream with black linework.
traits.Motion: Shapes wiggle on loop; nothing settles completely.

styles.title: Bauhaus Geometric
styles.short: Primary red, blue and yellow, pure circles, squares and triangles, and lowercase geometric type on a strict grid.
styles.long: Form follows function, executed with three primaries and three shapes. Compositions use circles, squares and triangles at large scale as the imagery itself, arranged on a mathematically obvious grid. Type is a geometric sans set entirely in lowercase, often rotated 90 degrees along an edge. Diagonals are used sparingly and always at 45 degrees.

traits.Typography: Geometric sans in lowercase (Futura lineage); vertical rotated labels along edges.
traits.Layout: Modular grid with large geometric shapes occupying whole modules.
traits.Colour: Red, blue, yellow, black and off-white. No tints, no gradients.
traits.Motion: Shapes rotate and translate along grid axes only.

styles.title: Art Deco Revival
styles.short: Gold linework on deep ink, symmetrical sunburst frames and high-waisted display capitals.
styles.long: Symmetry is the organising principle: a central axis with stepped fan and sunburst motifs, thin gold keylines forming layered frames, and chevron or scallop borders. traits.Layout: Strictly symmetrical about a central axis; layered rectangular gold frames.
traits.Colour: Deep navy or emerald with metallic gold and cream.
traits.Motion: Frames draw in from the centre outward.

styles.title: Japandi / Wabi-Sabi
styles.short: Raw plaster and unbleached linen tones, asymmetric ma spacing and a single imperfect brushstroke.
styles.long: Beauty in incompleteness: unbleached, plaster and charcoal tones; enormous asymmetric negative space treated as an active element rather than a leftover; and one imperfect mark — a brushstroke, a rough ceramic edge — as the only ornament. traits.Layout: Deliberately off-centre; content occupying a third of the canvas at most.
traits.Colour: Unbleached linen, plaster grey, clay and charcoal. No saturation.
traits.Motion: Extremely slow fades; nothing moves quickly.

traits.Layout: Narrow measure, wide margins, centred ornaments between sections.
traits.Colour: Ink, oxblood and forest with aged gold and parchment.

styles.title: Scandinavian Minimal
styles.short: Pale birch and chalk tones, honest photography, one muted accent and typography that never raises its voice.
styles.long: Functional warmth: near-white chalk grounds with pale birch and stone accents, product or interior photography shot in flat northern daylight, and a single muted colour — dusty blue, moss, terracotta — used at small scale. Type is a humanist sans at moderate sizes with a comfortable measure; nothing is oversized and nothing is decorative. Grids are even and predictable on purpose.

traits.Typography: Humanist sans at 16–48px; sentence case; comfortable 65ch measure.
traits.Layout: Even 3- and 4-column grids with consistent gutters; no full-bleed drama.
traits.Colour: Chalk white and birch with one muted accent used at under 5% coverage.
traits.Motion: Short, soft fades; no parallax.

styles.title: Kinetic Typography
styles.short: Type as the only content — stretched, wrapped, distorted along paths and animated on scroll.
styles.long: The page is built from words alone. Headlines are distorted along curves, wrapped around invisible cylinders, stretched to fill their container exactly, or split into per-letter units that respond to the cursor. Variable font axes are animated rather than swapped. Colour is usually reduced to two so the deformation reads clearly, and any image is subordinate to the lettering.

traits.Typography: Variable grotesk with animated weight and width axes; per-letter splitting.
traits.Layout: Type fills each viewport section completely; no cards, no images.
traits.Colour: Two colours, occasionally a third on hover.
traits.Motion: The whole point — scroll-driven weight, skew, path and scale animation.

styles.title: Terminal / Data-Dense
styles.short: Monospace everywhere, ASCII rules, tight row heights and a single phosphor accent on near-black.
styles.long: Built for people who like density: one monospace family at one or two sizes, rows packed to 20–24px, borders drawn with box characters or 1px hairlines, and a single phosphor green or amber accent for active states. Tables are the primary layout unit and whitespace is rationed. It signals capability and speed, which is why developer tools keep returning to it.

traits.Typography: One monospace family at 12–13px; caps for headers; no other family anywhere.
traits.Layout: Table-first, 20–24px row height, box-drawing or hairline borders, fixed left rail.
traits.Colour: Near-black with one phosphor accent and three greys.
traits.Motion: Cursor blink and instant state changes only.
